text: Hugh Finlayson (December 12, 1810 – June 3, 1889) was an Ontario businessman and political figure who represented Brant North in the Legislative Assembly of Ontario as a Liberal member from 1867 to 1879. Born in Edinburgh, Scotland in 1810, he arrived in North America in 1832, initially settling in New York City before moving to Brantford in Upper Canada in 1835. He eventually settled in Paris, Ontario, where he worked as a saddle and harness maker and operated a tannery. Finlayson served as mayor of Paris in 1858 and represented East Brant in the Legislative Assembly of the Province of Canada from 1858 to 1861. He was elected to the Ontario Legislative Assembly in 1867 and remained a member until 1879. He died in Paris in 1889. This article about an Ontario Liberal Party MPP is a stub.
